definitions.gloss: wild dancing; frenzied dancing; whirling about
definitions.explanation: Dancing wildly and without restraint, often out of great joy or excitement. Also used figuratively of things such as petals or snow whirling in the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乱舞|らんぶ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んで→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧{乱舞|らんぶ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The audience danced wildly with joy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スタンド→スタンド：00394_sutando⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乱舞|らんぶ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the championship was clinched, the fans danced wildly in the stands.

notes:
Dancing wildly and without restraint, typically from intense joy or excitement. Also used figuratively of petals, snow, or sparks whirling through the air.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歓喜|かんき}→歓喜：13172_kanki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乱舞|らんぶ}: a dance of joy
- ⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乱舞|らんぶ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: petals whirl about
- {乱舞|らんぶ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dance wildly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: to dance gracefully — {乱舞|らんぶ} stresses wild, unrestrained motion
